editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood gem serving authentic, made-right Mexican comfort food at prices that feel like a steal.
editorial.insiderTip: Go on a weekend when they serve menudo, and order at least 10 vapor tacos (50 cents each) — they're small but ridiculously good value and won't leave you feeling overstuffed.

topDishes.note: Amazing at 50 cents each, insane value and a must-order
